title: More Bits Won't Fix It: Diagnosing and Treating an Ill-Conditioned Backward Pass (A Case Study on Gemma-4)
abstract: arXiv:2611.27243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During LoRA fine-tuning of Gemma-4 (12B and 31B) on long prompts, whether they contain CT images, natural photos, or about 2,000 tokens of text, bf16 and fp32 gradients agree in the upper third of the language model (cosine similarity 0.96 or above) but are nearly orthogonal in the lower third. On image prompts, we trace the effect to an ill-conditioned backward path. The fp32 gradient is unchanged by element-wise relative noise of $10^{-6}$ on hidden states, confirming that fp32 is a valid reference. At $10^{-4}$, however, its cosine similarity with the noise-free gradient falls below 0.9 in 7 of 10 measurements, whereas bf16 forward states differ from fp32 states by about 1% per token. State swaps and backward-only interventions localize this sensitivity in Gemma-4-12B to the MLPs of layers 19-21 at image-token positions, where the gradient can be dominated by a single low-information patch. translated_title: 更多比特位也解决不了问题：诊断与治疗病态的反向传播路径（以Gemma-4为例的案例研究）
translated_abstract: 在对Gemma-4（12B和31B）进行长提示词的LoRA微调时——无论提示词包含CT图像、自然照片还是约2000个token的文本——我们发现bf16和fp32梯度在语言模型的上三分之一部分高度一致（余弦相似度达到0.96或以上），但在下三分之一部分却几乎正交。在图像提示词场景下，我们将这一现象追溯到一条病态的反向传播路径。在隐状态上施加10^-6量级的逐元素相对噪声时，fp32梯度保持不变，证实fp32可作为有效的参考基准。然而当噪声达到10^-4量级时，fp32梯度与无噪声梯度的余弦相似度在10次测量中有7次降至0.9以下，而bf16前向状态与fp32状态的差异约为每token 1%。通过状态交换和仅作用于反向传播的干预手段，我们将Gemma-4-12B中的这种敏感性定位于第19-21层的MLP模块在图像token位置处，在这些位置上，梯度可能被单个低信息量的图像块所主导。在反向传播中断开该路径即可……
tldr: Gemma-4的LoRA微调中bf16与fp32梯度在模型低层几乎正交，其根源是第19-21层MLP在图像token位置存在病态反向传播路径，且梯度可能被单个低信息图像块主导，在反向传播中断开该路径即可解决，而单纯提高数值精度并无帮助。
en_tdlr: In LoRA fine-tuning of Gemma-4, bf16 and fp32 gradients become nearly orthogonal in the lower third of the model due to an ill-conditioned backward path through the MLPs of layers 19-21 at image-token positions, where gradients can be dominated by a single low-information patch; detaching this path in the backward pass fixes the issue, showing that more numerical precision bits won't help.
